title: CIA director Bob Gates's first visit to Moscow and his toast

tellings.quote: And I'll never forget that trip in 19 fall of 1992.

plain: A former CIA officer, Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, says he went along on the first trip to Moscow by Bob Gates, then head of the CIA, the US foreign spy agency, in the fall of 1992, just after the Cold War ended. He tells it on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels and remembers a toast Gates gave there, saying he will never forget that trip. He tells it as a first-hand memory of a turning point between old enemies.
